decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until a Bird Hazard Management Plan detailing how the breeding and roosting of birds shall be controlled has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The Bird Hazard Management Plan shall include a timetable for implementation of any measures needed and shall be carried out as approved unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of  0800   to 1800   on Mondays to Friday and 0900 to 1300  on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until a proposed section at scale 1:5 and method statement to illustrate how the green roof will be constructed and maintained thereafter shall be provided and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commencement of works." (1:100 Roof plan, 1:5 section Specification, Method statement).
description: Replacement of the existing coping stones and the installation of a green roof system and solar collectors to four seperate blocks of flats.
